faucon_war.title: War of the Falcons
faucon_war.description: The Black Falcons have launched a full offensive against the Scarlet Guardians. Military routes are cut off.
faucon_war.shortDesc: Weapons & armor +50% · Fort Kharos and Citadel blocked · +15% combat

emporium_blockade.title: Emporium Blockade
emporium_blockade.description: Emporium Requiem has shut down its trade routes in retaliation for an unconfirmed incident. Supplies are running low.

epidemic.title: Spreading Epidemic
epidemic.description: An unknown pathogen is spreading from Quarantine Station. Authorities are trying to contain the situation.

cosmic_storm.title: Cosmic Storm
cosmic_storm.description: An ionized particle storm sweeps through the sector. Navigation systems are disrupted, travel is more dangerous.
cosmic_storm.shortDesc: +2 fuel per trip · +10% combat risk while traveling

bounty_hunt.title: Bounty Hunt
bounty_hunt.description: An unknown organization has placed bounties on independent travelers in this sector. Bounty hunters operate everywhere.
bounty_hunt.shortDesc: +25% combat risk everywhere · Bounty hunters active

colonial_famine.title: Colonial Famine
colonial_famine.description: Agricultural colonies suffered poor harvests. Food and water have become precious commodities across the sector.
colonial_famine.shortDesc: Food & water ×3 sale price · Trading opportunity

market_crash.title: Market Crash
market_crash.description: A massive financial manipulation crashed the markets. Everything sells and buys for next to nothing.
market_crash.shortDesc: All prices −35% · Good time to buy

artifact_rush.title: Artifact Rush
artifact_rush.description: Discoveries in the ruin zones have triggered a rush. Collectors and factions fight over ancient artifacts.
artifact_rush.shortDesc: Artifacts & classified data ×3 · Exploration more profitable

military_coup.title: Military Coup
military_coup.description: An internal putsch shakes the sector's military forces. Bases are under siege, civilians barred from entry.

guild_truce.title: Guild Truce
guild_truce.description: A temporary peace agreement between the major factions has been signed. Trade resumes freely, tensions ease.
guild_truce.shortDesc: All prices −20% · −15% combat risk · Good time to travel

grand_festival.title: Grand Orbital Festival
grand_festival.description: The Tribosphere and Scotty Golden North are hosting an inter-sector festival. Crowds flock in, credits flow.
grand_festival.shortDesc: Luxury & entertainment ×2 · Tribosphère and Scotty celebrating · -10% combat
